planned_arguments.prompt:
Create one finished SNS promotional poster for a weekend houseplant market: a single flat, opaque landscape 16:9 artwork, full bleed, directly generated with all lettering integrated. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Visual idea: a convivial illustrated market panorama read laterally. One uninterrupted oblique market tabletop threads across the composition and out of both side crops. It is the main spatial event, inhabited by distinctly sized living houseplants: one tall slender-stem tree, broad-leaf plants and small young plants in recognizable ochre and coral pots. At the left end an economically drawn visitor leans toward two contrasting plants to consider the choice; at the right end a grower in a plain apron gently steadies a newly potted plant at the pot rim. Make arm-to-hand ownership and each hand's simple contact with its own plant unambiguous. The plants and two people are substantial, varied-scale figures embedded in this continuous table, with lively foliage silhouettes, stems, pot rims, soil, and a few purposeful gardening objects without writing. Show the pleasure of choosing a plant and attending to its care. Do not turn the scene into a little illustration stripe below an unrelated information template.

Use confident figurative ink contours and broad dense colored planes: warm coral and ochre table/pots, restrained tomato-red accents, deep leafy blue-green masses, warm light open areas, charcoal type. Selective irregular drawn edges give life to the illustration, while all small lettering is precise, clean, flat printed typesetting. This is a warm social encounter with an uninterrupted horizontal rhythm, not photorealism, clay or toy 3D.

The real pot gaps and foliage silhouette open a generous reading space in the upper left. The slogan is the first reading anchor, in lively precise mid-weight Korean lettering, visually stronger and larger than the paragraph, wrapped after its comma into two meaningful phrase lines if helpful. Immediately below, start the full explanation at the same left alignment. Give it a substantial four-line editorial paragraph, with the first complete sentence on line one, the grower's-story phrase on line two, the home-light-and-lifestyle phrase on line three and the final plant-selection request on line four. The last two lines are one joined request. Budget the line width for actual Korean words and maintain comfortable prose readability when this image is viewed 720 pixels wide. Use mature Korean humanist sans anatomy: generous syllable bodies, open counters, stable consonant/vowel proportions, rounded restrained stroke terminals, consistent medium prose weight; proportional Latin with upright clear figures. Do not shrink body copy into a caption. Paragraph letters have no ink distress or perspective distortion.

The smaller Korean identifier and its directly adjoining compact upright Latin companion sit on the neighboring table-edge axis, plainly secondary to the slogan. The table's uninterrupted lateral edge carries the eye from the paragraph's last line toward the market-name entry at its right end. There, a single naturally open area bounded by the table and plant contours holds a stable visit-to-action column, not a boxed information card or a split background field. Market name, date, hours and venue are adjacent in that order; a short local gap leads to access and care as a pair; invitation and URL continue immediately below. Keep every entry spacious, high-contrast and legible at the 720-wide viewing assumption. The useful information should feel part of the same scene and reading path. The visitor and grower remain meaningfully connected by the real continuous tabletop around these reading openings.

Print exactly the following twelve entries, each once. Preserve every Korean/Latin glyph, meaningful word space, capital, number, comma, period, middle dot, ampersand, colon and URL. Line wraps are flexible only at meaningful word boundaries. Range dashes in date and hours are visibly extended midline en dashes, clear from the numeric baselines; keep their exact characters. This list order identifies copy only, not twelve numbered labels. Print no list numbers, labels or quotation marks:
집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.
leaves.example/market

No extra printed words or numerals anywhere, no plant tags, logo, watermark or QR. Exclude passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information templates with subordinate tiny imagery, texture or font substitutions, and empty-room text-board dressing. Here the continuous socially inhabited illustrated table, its foliage openings and contact actions must organize the whole poster and its copy. No mockup, frame, contact sheet, comparison panel or multiple posters. Only this one complete opaque 16:9 flat poster.

input_boundary: Focused production spec; literal full request and assignment separately pinned.
